Early clarity helps establish an appropriate scope and identify information gaps before a commercial proposal is developed.

Useful information to share

  • Project location and intended development
  • Ground investigation and groundwater information
  • Proposed excavation levels and site boundaries
  • Adjacent structures, utilities and access restrictions

Prepare your project enquiry ↗

Questions worth asking.

Can this method be selected from a website?

No. Suitability depends on ground conditions, loading, surroundings and project constraints. A qualified design team must determine the project solution.

Can I request an early discussion?

Yes. Send the project location, scope and current information through the enquiry form. It prepares a message for the Gravita WhatsApp contact.

How does this relate to the other disciplines?

Retaining walls, internal supports, excavation and groundwater management interact. Review them as a coordinated package rather than isolated activities.
